{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Blast targets with corrosive plasma projectiles, or toss the scepter to inflict nearby enemies with an energy field that amplifies their brain waves to attract bullets.}} The '''Scourge''' is {{WF|Harrow}}'s [[Signature Weapon|signature]] [[speargun]], firing fully automatic {{D|Corrosive}} projectiles that explode and damage nearby enemies in a small radius. Its [[Alternate Fire]] allows the very weapon itself to be thrown, inflicting a [[Homing#Homing Fields|Bullet Attractor]] field on the heads of all enemies near the impact point. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals {{D|Corrosive}} damage on its primary fire and primarily {{D|Impact}} damage on its alt-fire. *Primary Fire shoots plasma projectiles in an automatic fashion, causing a small '''1.7''' meter explosion on impact with a surface or enemy. **Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Can benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) and {{M|Cautious Shot}}. *[[Alternate Fire]] throws the Scourge, dealing damage and causing a '''2''' meter [[Homing#Homing Fields|Bullet Attractor]] field on the ''heads'' of enemies within '''14''' meters of the impact point, allowing easier headshots. **The Bullet Attractor stays on enemies for '''3''' seconds. The field pulses immediately on impact then once every '''5''' seconds. **Explosion bypasses Arctic [[Eximus]] globes and damages enemies within. **Guaranteed {{D|Impact}} proc. **Throwing the spear consumes 1 ammo, then reloads the weapon. **The field lasts for '''20''' seconds. **Only one field can be deployed at a time. Throwing the spear will remove existing fields. **Can benefit from {{M|Cautious Shot}}. *Reloads '''33%''' of the magazine per second while deployed or holstered. {{Advantages|class=Speargun| }} {{Disadvantages|class=Speargun| *Projectiles have travel time. *Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. *Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. *Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from: **100% to 70% from central impact on primary fire. **100% to 40% from central impact on alternate fire. }} {{WeaponComparison|Scourge Prime}} ==Acquisition== The Scourge's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Tenno Lab|Tenno Lab]] in the [[dojo]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} This weapon can be sold for '''7,500''' '''[[Credits]]'''. ==Notes== *Currently, Scourge lacks a [[Signature Weapon]] bonus with {{WF|Harrow}}/{{WF|Harrow Prime}}. *The Scourge's projectiles explode upon contact, and allows ​{{M|Firestorm}}​ to be equipped to increase the blast radius, although it will only increase by ~1 meter. *The Scourge's alt-fire throws the speargun towards the reticle, impaling enemies along its path with physical damage, then inflicting Corrosive damage in a large area of effect. Finally, it creates a pulse that applies a Bullet Attractor debuff on nearby enemies' ''heads''. **Bullets and projectiles fired at enemies will be drawn to the head. However, this does not guarantee a headshot. **The Bullet Attractor debuff will be applied the instant the weapon sticks to a surface, and subsequently in periodic pulses while the Scourge stays in place. There is a slight pause between their expiration and the next pulse; the Bullet Attractor effect lasts for 3 seconds and the weapon will pulse every 5 seconds, meaning there's a 2 second downtime. **Throwing Scourge at full ammo vs. 1 ammo left in the magazine does not have any notable difference (if any at all). ***The Scourge can only be thrown if it has at least 1 ammo remaining in the magazine. **{{M|Firestorm}}​ does not affect the size of the Bullet Attractor field, nor does it increase the range a thrown Scourge will apply its effect to enemies. **Weapons with buffs that apply on headshots such as {{Weapon|Knell}}, {{Weapon|Dual Toxocyst}} and {{Weapon|Athodai}} will benefit greatly from the Scourge's alt-fire effects as they will easily gain their respective headshot buffs. Similarly, headshot-conditions for {{Arcane|Arcane Pistoleer}} and {{Arcane|Arcane Precision}} can be easily achieved in this manner. **Throwing the weapon does not cost ammo. *An additional feature of the Scourge is its innate ability to replenish its magazine while holstered or thrown. In either state, the weapon fully reloads in 3 seconds (or 33% of the magazine size per second). **Reload speed mods such as {{M|Fast Hands}} do not affect the rate of replenishment. Mods such as {{M|Tactical Reload}}, and the [[Synth Set]], on the other hand, will increase said rate. *The Scourge has a unique visual effect with Harrow's Agile idle stance, where it will be collapsed into a smaller configuration when held. It extends to its full length when firing. ==Trivia== *A ''[[wikipedia:Scourge|Scourge]]'' refers to a whip with multiple thongs or "tails" (a [[wikipedia:Cat o' nine tails|Cat o' nine tails]] being a good example), and was often used for corporal punishment as well as for self-flagellation by religious penitents. In contemporary terminology, the term has been applied to people, groups, or events that resulted in great calamity. *While the separate reload time for the alt-fire does nothing, a bug used to allow this shorter reload time to be applied to the primary fire. It could be done by manually pressing the reload key while the spear-throw attack was charging. ==Known Bugs== *{{M|Galvanized Aptitude}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from primary fire. *{{M|Adhesive Blast}} could be used to allow the projectiles to stick then explode, but this feature was disabled, making the mod do nothing when equipped. *Has a high chance of disappearing when thrown. **This bug can be fixed by switching to an item such as [[Codex Scanner]] or entering a [[Bleedout]] state. *Using the Alternate Fire on Captain Vor during his final phase will crash the game, should his Void Key beam kill him. ==Media== ScourgeCodex.png|Scourge in the Codex. Scourge 1.png|Scourge in its collapsed form when held using harrow's agile animation Scouge.png|Scourge as is shown in the arsenal {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|6_XagYSFHys|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|CDkiNi1H9_4|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|YgW8kKVrwtE|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|Uub7Mjer8nk|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|6zY3TOlnq7k|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|38.5.11}} *Fixed a script error when hitting an enemy with a spear gun's alt-fire. {{ver|38.5.8}} *Fixed Scourge's Alt Fire not proc’ing for Clients. {{ver|38.0.8}} *Fixed Primary Exhilarate not triggering from Impact Status Effect that originate from Scourge. {{ver|33.5}} *Fixed Furis’ Incarnon Form causing self-damage when shooting an enemy that is affected by Scourge’s Alt-Fire. {{ver|32.3}} *Fixed Scourge projectiles swirling around Grendel after casting Feast on enemies affected by its alt fire. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 60 Ammo per Pick Up: *Scourge ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage. Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall. *Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions. **This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage. ;SPEAR GUN CHANGES We have changed the way that Spear Guns function in-game to help increase their viability in mission. Based on overwhelming community feedback we’ve: *Removed the need to manually retrieve your Spear Gun once it’s been thrown. Your Spear Gun now re-appears in your hand using reload. *Removed the need to charge your Spear Gun to throw it, simply Tap alt-fire to throw! **Within the arsenal, ‘Charged Throw’ stats have simply become ‘Throw’ stats. Spear Guns have also received new throw animations and updated sound FX on reload, plus a new Spear Gun category has been added when searching for weapons in the Arsenal. {{ver|31.1}} *Fixed Javlok projectiles flying side-on to the direction of travel when the Renuntio Speargun Skin is equipped. Also fixes the same scenario for the Scourge/Scourge Prime with the Carcinus Speargun Skin equipped. {{ver|29.6.4}} *Fixed a Dedicated Server script error in Conclave when using the Scourge. {{ver|27.4}} *Fixed the Scourge projectile trail FX appearing distorted. {{ver|27.2.2}}
Reduced the following AoE weapons Radial Damage Falloff from central impact that were all previously 90%: *Scourge: 30% / Alt Fire 60% {{ver|27.2}} ;Self Damage Changes: We are getting rid of Self Damage and replacing it with something else: instead of Self Damage, it’s now ‘Stagger’. This change completely removes the chance of killing yourself, and instead now creates scenarios where you will interrupt yourself - or ‘Stagger’ - to varying degrees if you aren’t careful. The degrees of Self-Interrupt start with a small stumble all the way to full knockdown depending on how close you are to the center of explosion. Any Mods referring to Self Damage will be converted to acknowledge Stagger. With this Self-Interrupt system, we have added dozens of new recovery animations that harness a ninja-like recovery experience. By pressing ‘Jump’ at the correct time, you can execute a ninja-skill-based knockdown recovery to ALL in-game knockdowns. This ninja recovery window is indicated by a glowing FX on your Warframe. In the original Dev Workshop, we said:
''As a result of this overall systemic change, Weapons with Stagger will be getting approximately a 20% buff in Damage, with any weapons with AOE receiving a 50% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact.'' This is no longer accurate after continued testing. What we are doing now is: No damage buffs have been added, but any weapons with AOE are receiving ~20% increase in Radius. Additionally, AOE weapons are receiving a 90% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact. This means on the very outer section of the explosion Radius 10% of the Damage will be dealt. Tactics will be deadly - aim true, Tenno. ''Why: Several players brought up the history of the Tonkor and we want to make sure we ship this change in a place that’s conservative in its starting point from a balance perspective. The complete removal of Self Damage does change the pace of destruction with some of the game’s most powerful weapons, so we want to make sure we can iterate upwardly instead of releasing a bonanza of explosions with no other choices.'' {{ver|25}} *33% of clip reloaded every second when Spear is deployed. This allows for a more fluid use of all the Gun Spear mechanics﻿.﻿﻿ *Increased Ammo pool from 100 to 200. *Increased Alt Fire's bullet attractor radius from 1.8m to 2m. *Increased Magazine size from 20 to 40. *Increased Primary fire area-of-effect damage from 30 to 55. *Primary Fire recoil reduced.﻿﻿ {{ver|24.5.2}} *Fixed missing Scourge hit sounds. {{ver|23.1.2}} *Fixed an issue with the Scourge's throw sounds playing when Modding. {{ver|22.12.3}} *Fixed the Scourge appearing to be rotated incorrectly when viewed on a surface {{ver|22.12}} *Damage from direct hits increased from 30 to 70 (Primary Fire). {{ver|22}} *Fixed Scourge not being affected by Adhesive Blast and Firestorm Mods. {{ver|21.4}} *Removed Corrosive radial AoE from Scourge in Conclave. *Scourge's bullet attractor now lasts 3 seconds in Conclave. {{ver|21.3.1}} *Adhesive Blast is no longer equippable on the Scourge. *Lessened the spread from the Heavy Caliber mod when used with the Scourge. {{ver|21.0.9}} *Fixed the Scourge not being affected by Heavy Caliber's accuracy reduction. *Fixed the Scourge damaging or killing players when picking it up while paused in Limbo’s Rift before it hits the ground. *Fixed the Scourge and Cycron Status lasting longer for the Host. *(undocumented) Fixed projectile being able to bypass Nullifier bubbles. {{ver|Chains of Harrow}} *Introduced. }} {{ver/Lu|25.3}} ==See Also== *{{Weapon|Scourge Prime}}, the [[Prime]]d counterpart. *{{Weapon|Knell}}, {{WF|Harrow}}'s signature sidearm. {{ResearchNav}} {{WeaponNav}} [[es:Scourge]] [[pt:Scourge]] [[ru:Кара_(оружие)]] [[Category:Corrosive Damage]] [[Category:Update 21]] [[Category:Tenno]] [[Category:Speargun]] [[Category:Thrown]] [[Category:Signature Weapons]] [[Category:Harrow]] [[Category:Weapons with Passives]] [[uk:Бич]]

'''Secondary Dexterity''' is a [[Arcane Enhancement#Secondary_Weapon_Arcanes|Secondary Arcane]] that on melee kill increases secondary damage for 20 seconds and stacks up to 6 times. At max rank, it also passively increases [[Melee Combo Counter]] duration.

Can be sold for {{cc|1,000}}.

==Effect==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]]
! Damage per Stack
! Total at 6 stacks
! Combo Duration
|-
| 0 || 10% || 60% || -
|-
| 1 || 20% || 120% || -
|-
| 2 || 30% || 180% || -
|-
| 3 || 40% || 240% || -
|-
| 4 || 50% || 300% || -
|-
| 5 || 60% || 360% || 7.5s
|}

{{Acquisition|Awarded for defeating [[Acolytes]] in [[The Steel Path]].}}

==Notes==
*The damage bonus stacks additively with other damage mods like {{M|Hornet Strike}}.
*When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
*Companions can also activate the melee kill condition if they are using a melee weapon such as Claws, Deconstructor or any of the Hound weapons.

==Tips==
*If players would rather prefer to focus on melee and not on shooting targets, they can opt to equip this Arcane and {{Arcane|Primary Dexterity}}, both at max rank, on their ranged weapons simply to provide their passive melee combo counter buffs that grant up to 15 seconds.
*When equipped on an [[Archgun]], the combo duration buff will still apply even if the archgun is never deployed, allowing for bonus combo duration without sacrificing your secondary weapon's Arcane slot.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|32}}
;1. b) Holster Speed Buffs & Mod Changes

These changes to Ammo encourage swapping between weapons, so we’ve taken the opportunity to dramatically increase the swapping speed between Primary and Secondary. The real purpose of your Secondary weapon is for it to be a backup to your Primary, but with the holster speeds the way they were before that vision was not realized - until now! 

In light of the overall speed buff to holster speed, we have made the following changes to the mods and Arcanes that offered holster speed stat increases: 

'''''(All stats below are shown at max rank)'''''

Secondary Dexterity Arcane: 

*Removed their “+60% Holster Speed” bonus.

{{ver|30.5}}
*Introduced.
}}

==See Also==
*{{Arcane|Primary Dexterity}}, the primary equivalent.

'''Secondary Deadhead''' is a [[Arcane Enhancement#Secondary_Weapon_Arcanes|Secondary Arcane]] that increases secondary weapon damage on weak point kill for 24 seconds and stacks up to 3 times. At max rank, it also passively increases [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot damage multiplier]] and reduces [[recoil]].

Can be sold for {{cc|1,000}}.

==Effect==

! [[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]]
! Damage per Stack
! Total at 3 stacks
! Headshot Multiplier
! Recoil
|-
| 0 || 20% || 60% || - || -
|-
| 1 || 40% || 120% || - || -

| 2 || 60% || 180% || - || -
|-
| 3 || 80% || 240% || - || -
|-
| 4 || 100% || 300% || - || -
|-
| 5 || 120% || 360% || +30% || -50%
|}

{{Acquisition|Awarded for defeating [[Acolytes]] in [[The Steel Path]].}}

==Notes==
*The damage bonus stacks additively with other damage mods like {{M|Hornet Strike}}.
*When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
*Headshot bonus stacks additively with similar buffs, such as {{A|Prowl}}.
*Kills from some status procs on the target's head do '''not''' count as a weak point kill.
**{{D|Electricity}} and {{D|Gas}} procs are able to trigger the effect when aimed at the head however, as they are able to land headshots themselves.
*'Precision' refers to direct hit weak points (not AoE).

== Tips ==
* Can be used on weapons which normally have a 1.0x multiplier to headshots (such as the {{Weapon|Catchmoon}}) to give them a 1.3x headshot multiplier and actually provide a benefit.
* Since Electricity and Gas procs are able to independently land headshots, they benefit twice from the headshot multiplier bonus. Both of these procs will have 1.69x headshot damage from the bonus.

'''Secondary Merciless''' is a [[Arcane Enhancement#Secondary_Weapon_Arcanes|Secondary Arcane]] that on kill increases secondary weapon damage for 4 seconds and stacks up to 12 times. At max rank, it also passively increases [[reload speed]].

Can be sold for {{cc|1,000}}.

==Effect==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]]
! Damage per Stack
!Total at 12 stacks
! Reload Speed
|-
| 0 || 5% || 60% || -
|-
| 1 || 10% || 120%  || -
|-
| 2 || 15% || 180% || -
|-
| 3 || 20% || 240% || -
|-
| 4 || 25% || 300% || -
|-
| 5 || 30% || 360% || 30%
|}

{{Acquisition|Awarded for defeating [[Acolytes]] in [[The Steel Path]].}}

==Notes==
*'''Only''' weapon kills from the weapon with Secondary Merciless counts for stacking this effect.
**Status kills count if the killing status was applied by the weapon with Merciless. 
**Lingering effects that deal damage usually count.
**Alt-fire modes usually count.
*Stacks of the buff are not shared between different weapons that have Secondary Merciless equipped, such as secondary [[Exalted Weapons]] and [[Archgun|Archguns]].
**Individual weapons have their own stacks which are stored and updated independently of other stacks of Secondary Merciless. 
*When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
**After reaching the maximum 12 stacks, the buff will take 48 seconds to fully expire.
*The damage bonus stacks additively with other damage mods like {{M|Hornet Strike}}.

==Tips==
*Useful on weapons that can already kill groups of enemies quickly, such as most explosive weapons or weapons that chain between targets. Less useful on slow firing weapons that rely on status effects to kill their targets like single shot rifles.
*Can be compared to {{Arcane|Secondary Deadhead}}, which has an identical maximum damage bonus of 360%, but acquires stacks on [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] kills, requiring fewer total kills for upkeep, and which can last for a total of 72 seconds, rather than the 48 seconds of Merciless.
*Can be compared to {{Arcane|Cascadia Flare}}, which has a higher maximum damage bonus of 480% by stacking on {{D|Heat}} procs rather than kills, but expiring all at once on a much faster 10 second duration, compared to the 48 second duration of Merciless.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|32}}
*Secondary Merciless Arcane: Removed its +100% Ammo Maximum bonus.

{{ver|30.5}}
*Introduced.
}}

==Notes==
*{{D|Overguard}} cap is '''15,000''' at all ranks.
*[[DoT]]s will also steal {{D|Overguard}}, [[AoE]] DoTs (e.g. {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Gas}}) and weapons (e.g. {{Weapon|Aegrit}}) are great at improving crowd control over [[Eximus]].
*The {{D|Overguard}} steal effect can be "[[Heat Inherit|inherited]]" if the first source of {{D|Heat}} status applied to an enemy was from a secondary with this Arcane active.
**Extra damage to {{D|Overguard}} is not inheritable and is dynamically applied, so the effect is lost entirely after depleting the {{D|Overguard}} from an enemy.
*Since {{D|Overguard}}'s immunity period is 0.5 seconds, any secondary with a firing rate >2.0 can maintain functional immortality as long as you can keep firing and there's overguard to steal.
**This can be accomplished with {{Weapon|Grimoire}} and {{M|Lethal Torrent}} by providing a 2.4 Fire Rate with its infinite ammo.

{{ArcaneBox}}'''Secondary Enervate''' is an [[Arcane Enhancement]] for Secondary Weapons that increases [[Critical Hit#Critical Chance|Critical Chance]] on hit, resetting after a certain number of [[Critical Hit#Critical Tiers|Big Critical Hits]]. ==Effect== {| class="emodtable" |- !Rank !Critical Chance Increase !Big Critical Hit Reset |- |0||10% |1 |- |1||10% |2 |- |2||10% |3 |- |3||10% |4 |- |4||10% |5 |- |5||10% |6 |- |} {{Acquisition|*Can be bought from [[Eleanor]] of {{Faction|The Hex}} for {{sc|7,500}} at '''Rank 5 - Pizza Party'''. *Rewarded from the [[1999 Calendar]]. *Rewarded from Techrot Safes in [[Höllvania]] missions. *Rewarded from Scaldra Caches in Höllvania [[Exterminate]] missions. *Dropped by the {{E|H-09 Efervon Tank}} in Höllvania [[Assassination]] missions. *Rewarded from Höllvania [[Faceoff]] missions. *Dropped by the {{E|Scaldra Screamer}} in Höllvania [[Stage Defense]] missions.}} ==Notes== *Critical chance is an absolute bonus. For example, a {{Weapon|Lato}} with 7 stacks of Secondary Enervate will have :::{{Weapon|Lato|10%}} + (7 × {{Arcane|Secondary Enervate|10%}}) = 80% critical chance. *{{Text|var(--orange-crit-color)|Big Critical Hits}} are any tier above regular Critical Hits that appear when the weapon has more than 100% critical hit chance, with orange and red damage numbers by default. *[[Hitscan]] attacks that hit multiple enemies simultaneously (e.g., because of [[Multishot]] or [[Punch Through]]) count as only one hit. **[[Projectile]] and non-chained [[Continuous Weapon|Beam]] attacks that hit multiple enemies simultaneously '''will count''' as multiple hits. ***If a weapon fires multiple projectiles per shot in a delayed fashion, such as the {{weapon|Kompressa}} and its bubbles, occasionally one shot will register as multiple hits because the game seems to use a grace period where projectiles from the same shot won't register more times. ***Similarly, the delayed explosions also provide wildly inconsistent bonuses due to the fact that the delay varies between 0.6-0.8 seconds, and if the explosions happen to overlap they will register os one hit. **[[Area of Effect|AoE]] attacks always count as one hit. *When used with a Shotgun Sidearm such as the [[Pyrana]], each pellet does not count as a separate damage instance as the pellets are tied to Multishot. *Hits on an Arctic [[Eximus]]'s Snow Globe can build the critical chance bonus without triggering the reset, since the globe has {{D|Object}}-based health that cannot take critical hits. While this can build the critical chance bonus to extreme levels, the burden of preparation still outweighs the benefit as the bonus will eventually reset. *Damage dealt by expiring {{D|Blast}} procs counts as a hit. **{{D|Blast}} proc explosions that occur when reaching maximum stacks or killing the target '''do not''' count as a hit. *The average final crit chance (AFCC) over a large number of shots, with the modded crit chance of the weapon being x% (and including additional bonuses such as {{Arcane|Arcane Avenger}}), will be: : AFCC(x) = \begin{cases} 102.45 + 0.5x,\; & x < 110 \\ 128.8 - 0.0075x + 0.00244x^{2},\; & 110 \leq x < 140 \\ 77.5 + 0.7x,\; & 140 \leq x < 150 \\ 70 + 0.75x,\; & 150 \leq x < 160 \\ 62 + 0.8x,\; & 160 \leq x < 170 \\ 53.5 + 0.85x,\; & 170 \leq x < 180 \\ 44.5 + 0.9x,\; & 180 \leq x < 190 \\ 35 + 0.95x,\; & 190 \leq x < 200 \\ 25 + x,\; & x \geq 200 \end{cases} *AFCC values are accurate within a 0.1% up to 140% modded crit chance, and exact from 140% onwards. These results are based on the full Probability Tree Diagram for each integer-valued modded crit chance, with linear regression on the values up to 110% modded crit chance, and polynomial regression (degree 2) from 110% to 140%. *Both critical chance bonus and reset stacks cannot trigger more than 30 times per second. *Multiple big critical hits registered within 1 game tick only count as 1 stack for the reset counter. [https://wiki.warframe.com/w/User:SMGFXYJQ/Hits_Mechanism#GameTick_Time_Determination GameTick] *The absolute effect of Secondary Enervate can be found by subtracting modded crit chance from AFCC. The effect of Secondary Enervate is significantly higher at low modded crit values, and is displayed in a chart below for given crit values. [[File:Enervate2.png|center]] ==Tips== *Works exceptionally well with the {{Weapon|Kuva Nukor}} due to its massive [[Critical Damage]] multiplier. *The {{Weapon|Kompressa}} ({{Weapon|Kompressa Prime|Prime}}) can fire so many projectiles and delayed explosions that the critical chance bonus can continue to build up well past '''200%''', allowing for {{text|red|tier 3+}} crits until the bonus resets. ==Acquisition==
*Can be bought from [[Roathe]] at [[La Cathédrale]] in the [[Sanctum Anatomica]] for 5 {{Resource|Maphica}}.
*May appear as a [[Steel Path]] [[The Descendia]] reward on a weekly rotational basis.
**Infernum 6 and 13 awards 1.
**Infernum 20 awards 3.

== Notes ==
*Only direct hits spread to nearby enemies.
**Includes secondary hits, such as split beams from {{Weapon|Tenet Cycron}} and bullet ricochet from {{Resource|Sicarus Incarnon Genesis}}.
**Additional shots from [[Multishot]] will not apply additional hits but will instead be multiplied by the multishot
***Status effects spread by this will also be multiplied by multishot even if only 1 actually procced a status effect.
*Spread hits from projectile weapons are inconsistent an differ depending on the weapon.
**For example: The {{Weapon|Epitaph Prime}} hit will only deal 84% of the original hit, while the {{Weapon|Kuva Seer}} will deal 260%
*Spread hits require '''[[line of sight]]''' to damage enemies.
*Spread hits can only apply 1 [[Status Effect]] per instance.
**{{M|Hemorrhage}} will bypass this if impact is shared but only once per enemy.
*Elemental mods are '''33% less effective''' on the spread hits.
*{{M|Galvanized Shot}} does '''not''' work on the spread hit.
*{{A|Xata's Whisper}} will multiply both the spread hit and the xata's hit by 2 independently from multishot.
*Spread hits count as regular body hits and calculate damage separately from the original hit.
**Cannot benefit from headshot or weakpoint multipliers, even if the original hit did.
**Will not deal spread hit damage to enemies which require hitting specific parts of their bodies, such as {{E|The Severed Warden}}, but can still apply status effects to them.
**Will roll a separate critical hit chance per enemy 
*Spread hits can proc various weapons' unique on-hit effects:
**{{Weapon|Arca Scisco}}'s Target Analysis (only sometimes procs)
**{{Weapon|Magnus Prime}} and {{Weapon|Akmagnus Prime}}'s Chamber Cascade.

== Tips ==
*Due to the nature of how the area damage effect is calculated, weapons with high fire rates and status are significantly more useful than slow firing weapons with low status chance.
* Several abilities are able to afflict enemies with {{D|Radiation}} quickly, such as {{WF|Nyx}}'s {{A|Chaos}} and {{WF|Oberon}}'s {{A|Smite}} ('''10''' stacks immediately), or Oberon's {{A|Hallowed Ground}} ('''2''' stacks per second, up to '''6''' stacks per second if multiple casts are stacked), allowing the arcane to function without needing to mod the damage type into your weapons.
